mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises rapidly and the federal funds rate fails to rise in response, it signals delayed monetary policy that compresses real rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime where industrial production growth is below 0.5% annually, reduced corporate output and profit margins lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO 12m growth is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) growth exceeds 0.8% MoM, it signals robust consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS MoM exceeds 0.8%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the risk of aggressive monetary tightening leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
